name: PENTECH
recent: Pentech 在 2026 年 11 月 17 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩，新闻标题显示第三季净利环比增长 79.84% 至 815 万令吉。此前，公司于 10 月 16 日公告一名独立非执行董事在公开市场增持 5 万股。新闻亦提及 Pentech Solution 有意拓展海外市场。

recent_en: Pentech announced its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November 2026, with a news headline indicating 3Q net profit rose 79.84% quarter-on-quarter to RM8.15 million. Earlier, on 16 October, the company announced that an independent non-executive director acquired 50,000 shares in the open market. News also mentioned that Pentech Solution is eyeing overseas expansion.
notable_en: Announced results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, with a news headline indicating 3Q net profit rose 79.84% quarter-on-quarter to RM8.15 million.
Independent non-executive director Dr Lim Guan Chong acquired 50,000 ordinary shares in the open market on 16 October 2026.
A news headline mentioned that Pentech Solution is eyeing overseas expansion.
